rationale: Secreted phosphoprotein. Elevated serum levels in cirrhosis across multiple cohorts. Promotes HSC activation via CD44.
Galectin 3. FDA cleared serum biomarker for cardiac fibrosis. Inhibitor belapectin in Phase 2/3 for NASH cirrhosis.
Defines the SAMac population. Serum TREM2 measurable by ELISA and correlates with fibrosis stage. Blocking strategies reduce fibrosis in preclinical models.
PDGF receptor alpha on myofibroblasts. Imatinib class inhibitors available. PDGFRalpha cell frequency correlates with histological fibrosis stage.
Canonical fibrosis gene. ASO and small molecule strategies targeting collagen production in development. PINP propeptide measurable in serum.
Inhibits MMP mediated ECM resolution. Serum TIMP1 is a component of the ELF score which is FDA cleared.
Collagen IV remodeling enzyme. Serum MMP2 used in fibrosis indices.
Soluble ICAM1 measurable in plasma. Correlates with inflammatory activity in cirrhosis.
Drives CCR2 positive monocyte recruitment feeding SAMac expansion. Cenicriviroc validated this axis in Phase 3.
Defines scar associated endothelium. IHC marker of fibrotic septa. Modulates leukocyte trafficking.
Glycoprotein NMB. Serum and plasma detectable. Anti-GPNMB ADC in clinical trials for other indications making it a repurposing candidate.
Fibronectin 1. Core ECM scaffold. EDA-FN isoform is fibrosis specific. Targeted drug conjugates in early development.
Crosslinks collagen and promotes ECM stiffness. Simtuzumab failed Phase 3 but next generation small molecule inhibitors are in development.
TWEAK cytokine. Key SAMac to HSC paracrine signal via Fn14. Anti-TWEAK antibody blocks HSC activation in experimental fibrosis.
Capillarization marker co expressed with ACKR1. Detectable by IHC. Potential imaging target.
